basics.name: Sixto Manuel Cáceres Terrones
basics.label: AI Engineer — LLM agents, MCP and evals
basics.summary: AI engineer who puts LLM agents into production and measures whether they work. Built SAM's MCP server (43 permission-scoped tools used from ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor) and its tool-calling assistant, now on paid plans. Thesis on LLM Text-to-SQL raised accuracy from 54% to 69% on BIRD and from 75% to 85% on Spider. Ships end to end, from client discovery to deployed web and mobile apps.

work.name: Nyro Operating Studio
work.summary: Software for business clients, from operational discovery and architecture to deployment and support.
highlights: Android app and multi-company web portal for industrial-safety operations, integrating Huawei REST API data with company reports and certificates.
Offline-first Android maintenance-reporting app that syncs on reconnect, with a Cloudflare Workers dashboard and private R2 photo storage.
Retail workflows for sales, cash, inventory, expenses and payment reconciliation; searchable medical catalog for a healthcare business.

work.name: SAM
work.summary: AI-native personal finance platform (web, PWA and Android).
highlights: Remote MCP server with 43 typed tools: per-user scopes, hashed bearer tokens, audit logs with redacted inputs and a stateless JSON-RPC transport for Cloudflare Workers; works with ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor.
In-app assistant (Samy) on the same tool catalog, with long-term user memory, an off-topic guardrail, confirmation before writes and per-plan usage metering.
Free, Pro and Agent plans with server-enforced quotas on AI messages and MCP calls; first paid accounts in November 2026.

courses: Thesis: selective error recovery for LLM-generated Text-to-SQL

projects.name: Text-to-SQL error recovery with LLMs (B.Sc. thesis)
highlights: Selects among LLM-generated SQL candidates using execution evidence, learned quality estimators and question-coverage checks.

Paired retrospective evaluation on 788 BIRD and 646 Spider questions: accuracy 54.2% to 69.3% (BIRD) and 74.8% to 85.3% (Spider); net error reduction 38.9% and 42.5% after counting regressions. Not an official leaderboard score.
Preregistered pilots with frozen splits, bootstrap confidence intervals and hashed provenance; null results reported.

projects.name: Radar Electoral: distributed NLP pipeline
highlights: 160,464 Peruvian political live-chat comments processed with Kafka (KRaft), Flink and Spark on AWS EMR.
Offensiveness classifier evaluated at 0.88 accuracy; label audit of a 16,710-row Spanish training set.

projects.name: RAG research
highlights: Ran HippoRAG (graph-based retrieval) with GPT-4o-mini and NV-Embed-v2 and prototyped SURE; measured Recall@k and QA exact match / F1.
